info.name: XTable Game Management API
info.description:
Complete API documentation for the XTable Game Management System (Laravel 12).

Base URL: `{{base_url}}/api/v1`

**Game Segments for History endpoints:**
| URL Segment | Game |
|---|---|
| `baccarat` | Baccarat |
| `andarbahar` | Andar Bahar |
| `dragontiger` | Dragon Tiger |
| `threecardpoker` | Three Card Poker |
| `blackjack` | Blackjack |
| `miniflush` | Mini Flush |
| `casinowar` | Casino War |

**Card Notation:** `Rank + Suit` e.g. `Ah` (Ace of Hearts), `Kd` (King of Diamonds), `10c` (10 of Clubs), `2s` (2 of Spades)

**Ledger Transaction States:** `0`=new, `2`=claimed, `1`=complete

request.description: Returns tables that currently have an open float session. Used by POS terminals on boot.
Looks up which table is registered to a given MAC address.
Returns the full game-specific preset configuration for a table.

Registers a POS device to a table by MAC. Three outcomes:
- `MAC_REGISTERED` (200) — first-time binding
- `MAC_ALREADY_REGISTERED` (200) — same device re-registering
- `MAC_CONFLICT` (409) — table already bound to a different device

response.body: {"success":true,"code":"MAC_REGISTERED","message":"MAC address registered successfully for table 'Baccarat Table 1'.","data":{"table_id":1,"table_name":"Baccarat Table 1","active_mac":"AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF","registered_at":"2026-09-06T12:00:00.000000Z"}}

item.name: 4. Ledger (Transactions)
item.description:
All financial transaction types. Requires an open session for the gameday.

**Transaction Types & Float Impact:**
| Type | Float Effect | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| FILL | +amount | Chips added from vault |
| CREDIT | +/- signed amount | Pit credit or deduction |
| ADJUST | +/- signed amount | Manual correction |
| CASHOUT | -amount | Player withdraws chips |
| BUYIN (CHIPS) | +amount | Chip purchase increases float |
| BUYIN (CASH) / DROP | no change | Cash goes to drop box |
| PAYOUT | no change | Accounting only |
| LOSS | +amount | Losing chips swept to tray |
| BET | no change | Chips in betting circle |
| VOID | no change | Correction via opposite txn |

request.description: Signed credit. Positive = add to float. Negative = deduct from float.
Manual signed float adjustment. Use positive or negative amounts.
Player buys in with chips (chip-to-chip exchange). Float increases. `payment_medium` is REQUIRED for BUYIN.
Cash buy-in (DROP). Cash goes into the drop box — float balance does NOT change. Displayed as `DROP` in API responses.
Player cashes out chips. Float balance decreases.
Winning chips paid to player. Tab balance increases. Float unchanged (accounting only).
Stake placed. Deducted from player tab. Float unchanged (chips in betting circle, not tray).
Losing chips swept from betting circle into tray. Float balance increases. Tab unchanged (already reduced at BET time).
Void marker. Float/tab unchanged. Correction handled by the paired opposite transaction.
Returns paginated (50/page) transactions for a table. `DROP` filter → `BUYIN + CASH medium`.

item.name: 5. Game History
item.description: Record game rounds and query history per game type. Replace `{game}` in the URL with: `baccarat`, `andarbahar`, `dragontiger`, `threecardpoker`, `blackjack`, `miniflush`, or `casinowar`.

request.description:
**winner:** `player` | `banker` | `tie`
**bet_position:** `player` | `banker` | `tie` | `player_pair` | `banker_pair` | `lucky6`
**side_win:** comma-separated e.g. `"player_pair,lucky6"` or `null`
**shoe_no:** nullable

**winner:** `andar` | `bahar`
**bet_position:** `andar` | `bahar` | `super_andar` | `super_bahar`
**joker_card:** single card string

**winner:** `dragon` | `tiger` | `tie`
**bet_position:** `dragon` | `tiger` | `tie`
**dragon_card / tiger_card:** single card string each

**winner:** `player` | `dealer` | `tie`
**bet_position:** `ante` | `pair_plus` | `six_card_bonus`
**player_cards / dealer_cards:** exactly 3 cards each

**winner:** `player` | `dealer` | `tie` | `blackjack` | `bust`
**bet_position:** `main` | `pair` | `777_charlie`
`double_amount` = additional stake placed on double-down.
`insurance_amount` = side bet placed when dealer shows an Ace.
`split_hands` array — each object has `split_no`, `cards`, `double_amount`, `insurance_amount`, `bet_amount`, `winner`, `win_amount`. Parent row summarises the overall hand.

**winner:** `player` | `dealer` | `tie`
**bet_position:** `main` | `hl`
**side_win:** `hl` | `null`

**winner:** `player` | `dealer` | `tie` | `war`
**bet_position:** `main` | `tie`
**player_cards[0]** = initial card, **player_cards[1]** = war card (if went to war)
**side_win:** `tie` if tie bet won, `null` otherwise
